I've farmed this 1.5 mu for 10 years now, since I finished middle school and came back home. My family has six mouths and my wife and I work the field while my younger brother sends money from his factory job in Shijiazhuang. Every yuan I spend on inputs is a yuan I can't use somewhere else, so I calculate carefully.

I grow cotton because the buyer comes to our village and I know I can sell it. Last year I planted guoxinmian, the improved seed my neighbor Old Wang used, and I got about 560 jin per mu. This year I will stick with that — I will buy 2 jin of improved seed per mu from the dealer in town. Last time I bought cheap seed to save 20 yuan and the germination was bad, so I learned my lesson.

For fertilizer, I will spread two 50-kg bags of compound fertilizer per mu — 100 kg total. The dealer sells it as 20-10-10. I figured that out: 20 percent of 100 kg is 20 kg nitrogen, 10 percent is 10 kg phosphorus, and 10 percent is 10 kg potassium per mu. I will put it all down as basal before sowing. I thought about adding urea at flowering, but last year I didn't and still got decent cotton, and my daughter's school fees are due soon. With only 1.5 mu, I can't afford every extra input, but 100 kg per mu is enough that I won't lose yield. A bad harvest is a disaster; wasting a little fertilizer is just a cost I accept.

I will irrigate three times from my well. First right after sowing to get the seeds to sprout, second in early July when flowering starts, and third in August when the bolls are filling. The pump uses electricity, but if cotton dries out during flowering, the bolls drop and you lose everything. I would rather pay for water than risk ruin.

For pesticides, cotton bollworm and aphids are bad here. I will spray 10 times this year, roughly every 10 days from June to August. The dealer mixes the medicine. Last year I sprayed 10 times and had only a little damage. Some farmers spray 15 times, but 10 is what I have money for.

I expect about 560 jin per mu — that is 280 kg per mu. If the rain comes at the right time, maybe I get 600 jin, but I plan for 560.
